01.gpt_prompt:
Premium Instagram news post (4:5), high-end tech creator style, Photoshop composite. Use the man from the reference photo exactly as he is (same face, black beard, clear transparent-frame glasses, brown sweater, arms crossed, warm smile), cut out, placed on the right side, waist up.
Background: clean light gray-white studio (#EEF1F3) with soft shadows.
On the left side, a large glossy 3D laptop at a slight angle, its screen shows a clean generic chat window (no app logos) with a finished document open in a side panel, three paper files floating out of the screen. Soft glassmorphism cards floating around it with small icons (a document icon with the word "Ata", a megaphone icon with the word "Comunicado", a tag icon with the word "Promoção").
Top left, small dark navy pill label with white text: "RADAR DE IA".
Big bold headline at the top in dark navy (#0B1A33), heavy condensed sans-serif, 2 lines: "Arquivo pronto não é" and in a blue accent (#2F6BFF): "arquivo revisado".
Bottom, small dark text: "Gemini agora cria e edita arquivos no chat."
Write all text exactly as given, Brazilian Portuguese with perfect accents. Clean, modern, premium, realistic lighting and shadows, no extra text, no logos, no watermark.
